# Tasha Brooks — Lead Tutor & Site Coordinator

- **Relationship:** skip-down; reports to [Sarah Chen](sarah-chen.md). Coordinates the two largest
  tutoring sites and mentors newer volunteer tutors.
- **Owns (on the ground):** day-to-day delivery of the
  [After-School Tutoring Program](../projects/after-school-tutoring.md) at her sites; the volunteer
  tutor onboarding others copy.

## Notes
- Beloved by students and families; a retention anchor for the volunteer corps.
- The staffer most exposed if the [Hearthstone funding](../projects/hearthstone-grant.md) gap forces
  program cuts — Cam wants to protect her role. Don't pile board/donor asks on her directly.
